title: pilosella echioides subsp. procera
intro: Pilosella echioides subsp. procera, commonly known as False Hawksbeard, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) characterized by its erect stems and small, yellow flowers. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella echioides subsp. procera are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic effects of this plant, but it has shown promise in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions.
